channel.title: Escape to the Country
channel.desc: Denise Nurse is in Nottinghamshire, helping Canadian house hunter Shane swap London life for the countryside. He's bringing his two cats but dreams of a garden big enough for a couple of dogs too. The property search includes a brilliant 3-for-1 mystery house with not one but two annexes. Denise also heads to Sherwood Forest to discover how climate change is affecting its ancient oak trees and learns about what's being done to protect them.
